content.short: BarnBridge is an open-source DeFi protocol for hedging interest-rate volatility by swapping variable yields for fixed rates.
content.description: BarnBridge is an open-source DeFi protocol on Ethereum that focuses on risk-tokenization. Co-founded by Troy Murray and Tyler Ward in 2019, it enables users to hedge interest-rate volatility in DeFi markets by swapping variable yields for a fixed rate, and then borrowing against that fixed-rate position. The protocol is governed by the BarnBridge DAO and uses the native BOND token for governance. BarnBridge v2 was launched in September 2022.
